summary: Waldencast plc (Nasdaq: WALD) filed a Form 6-K announcing its board-approved voluntary delisting of Class A ordinary shares and $11.50-exercise warrants from Nasdaq and Section 12(b) deregistration. Form 25 expected on or about September 24, 2026, with last trading day October 2 and delisting effective October 4; Form 15 to suspend reporting around October 5. The board cited disproportionate listing and reporting costs after the Obagi Medical divestiture left a single brand. Shareholders will vote at an EGM to rename the company Milk Makeup plc, with OTC quotation sought under ticker MLKM. Watch liquidity and warrant overhang.
